application: ProjectHub - Manager's Project Management Web App
archetype: Notion & Linear Inspired High-Density Productivity Workspace
theme: Light mode primary with soft off-white canvas, crisp slate borders, and vibrant indigo interactive accents

scale.caption: text-xs text-slate-500 font-medium
scale.mono_tag: text-xs font-mono tracking-wide text-slate-500 bg-slate-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded

layout_and_navigation.structure: Fixed left sidebar navigation (60px minimized / 240px expanded), sticky minimal header with unified search and quick-actions (+ Project, + Task), main scrollable workspace with multi-tab support, and a contextual right slide-over panel for inspectable details.
layout_and_navigation.spacing_philosophy: Linear/Notion inspired 4px grid. Generous internal card padding (p-5 to p-6), tight content grids with explicit gaps (gap-4 to gap-6). Thin hairline borders (1px solid #E2E8F0) with soft drop shadows (shadow-sm).

screens_and_components.login: Clean split or centered minimal card with email/password authentication, demo credentials quick-fill button, and brand indicator.
screens_and_components.dashboard: Manager overview with 4 KPI summary cards (Active Projects, Tasks Due, Team Size, Completion Rate), active project cards with interactive progress bar & milestones indicator, upcoming deadlines stream, and recent activity log.
screens_and_components.projects: Filterable grid & list view of projects, status badges (Planning, In Progress, On Hold, Completed), progress percentage, assigned lead avatars, cover thumbnail option, and Create/Edit/Archive modal dialogs.
screens_and_components.project_detail: Tabbed detail hub containing: Overview, Tasks, Files & Attachments, Activity Log, and Comments stream.
screens_and_components.kanban_board: Interactive Drag-and-Drop board with status columns (Backlog, To Do, In Progress, Under Review, Completed). Quick inline task card creation, card tags, priority badges, assigned user avatars, and drag handles.
screens_and_components.team_management: Grid of team members showing avatar, role, current workload meter, active tasks counter, email, and task assignment action.
screens_and_components.files_library: Object storage files browser with file type icons (PDF, Figma, Code, Image, Doc), file size, uploader avatar, preview modal, and download trigger.
screens_and_components.reports_analytics: Interactive Recharts visual analytics: Task completion rate over time (Area Chart), Team workload distribution (Bar Chart), Project status breakdown (Donut/Pie Chart), and Velocity metric cards.
screens_and_components.notifications_center: Unified notification feed with filter tabs (All, Mentions, Slack Alerts, System), read/unread toggle, and direct action deep-links.
screens_and_components.settings: Slack Webhook integration configuration panel (Webhook URL input, test alert button, alert trigger checkboxes), profile settings, and workspace preference toggles.

testing_attributes.guidelines: Every interactive and key informational element MUST have a unique role-based data-testid in kebab-case.

instructions_to_main_agent: Utilize lucide-react icons for navigation and actions.
Utilize recharts for dashboard analytics and reports charts.
Ensure sonner is used for toast notifications (e.g., 'Slack test alert sent!', 'Task status updated').
Keep background colors soft off-white (#FAFBFD) with solid white (#FFFFFF) for card surfaces to establish clear visual contrast without overwhelming shadows.
Integrate interactive drag-and-drop or column movement for the Kanban board.
Support full CRUD operations (Create, Edit, Delete/Archive, Status Change) across Projects, Tasks, Team Members, and Files with mock state management.
Include a functional Slack notification simulator with configurable webhooks in Settings and instant alert popups/toasts.
